Class Brick

DynamicRectangleEntity
org.example.entities.objects.Brick
public class Brick extends DynamicRectangleEntity
A single destructible brick that the ball can break. Bricks can require more than one hit; after the first hit they turn visually darker.

      public Brick(Coordinate2D position, Color color, int hitsLeft)
      Creates a brick at the given position with the specified color and hit count.
      Parameters:
      position - the top-left position of the brick
      color - the fill color when at full health
      hitsLeft - the number of hits required to destroy this brick

  • Method Details

    • hit

      public boolean hit()
      Registers a hit on this brick. If the last hit was taken the brick removes itself.
      Returns:
      true if the brick was destroyed, false if it still has hits remaining
